# 🧠 Multi-Agent AI Observability & Logging Framework

Production-grade observability and structured logging framework for multi-agent AI systems.  
Designed to enable traceability, failure propagation analysis, governance monitoring, and reliability engineering using fully open-source tools.

---

## 🚀 Overview

Modern agentic AI systems fail in complex ways.  
Failures rarely occur in isolation — they emerge from sequences of decisions across multiple agents.

This repository presents a **production-ready observability architecture** for multi-agent systems, including:

- Structured JSON logging
- Trace-based decision tracking
- Parent-child span relationships
- Failure propagation reconstruction
- Escalation and risk monitoring
- Role-based dashboard design
- Governance-ready audit trails

---
